verdict.rationale: The API covers most core operational surfaces that the UI exposes. Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated via the API as well as the web app. Endpoints and a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema also cover customer screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring configuration, exports, case audit trails, IAM roles and transaction processing. However, API credentials are created in the web application, and there is no evidence that screening configurations or the risk-score equation can be set up via the API, so full UI parity is not shown. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, API-based credential and access management, API configuration of screening configurations and risk-scoring equations, independent hands-on verification.
